# Chessground 9.2.1

This directory vendors the upstream Chessground 9.2.1 browser distribution for
the Course Studio editor and learner preview. It is served locally so the
Studio has no runtime CDN dependency.

- Upstream: https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground/tree/v9.2.1
- License: GPL-3.0-only; complete license text: `LICENSE`
- Files: `chessground-9.2.1.min.js`, `chessground.base.css`, and the Cburnett
  piece theme `chessground.cburnett.css`.

The vendor files are unmodified upstream distribution assets.
